Concern: No in-app/email alert when OB request enters Branch A Level-1 queue
Change / verification notes (English): If product promises alerts, verify delivery; else note gap for BA.

Concern: Rejection notification still references old Rejected Other Branches Opening deep link
Change / verification notes (English): Link opens Other Branch Approval Rejected with record context.

Concern: Account number allocated at Branch B before final OB approval and never released on reject
Change / verification notes (English): On reject, number recycling / reservation policy must match bank standards; no orphan active numbers.

Concern: Customer inquiry shows 'pending account' at Branch B after OB reject
Change / verification notes (English): Rejected openings must not appear as open/pending accounts in inquiry.

Concern: CBS/core sync creates account on OB submit rather than on final activation
Change / verification notes (English): No core account until activation per URS (rejected ⇒ no account).

Concern: Not Allowed mode still allows Save as Draft that later converts under Allowed config
Change / verification notes (English): Drafts must re-evaluate rule at submit time; no bypass.

Concern: Bypassing UI via browser console to skip customer-select validation
Change / verification notes (English): Server enforces detection; client-only checks insufficient.

Concern: Selecting customer then switching branch context mid-session confuses home-branch detection
Change / verification notes (English): Branch context stable; detection uses customer's account branch vs opening branch.

Concern: Reassign / delegate Level-2 while request in flight drops visibility for both users
Change / verification notes (English): Delegation policy: request remains visible to entitled role; no stuck Pending.

Concern: Approver at wrong level can open stepper via shared URL from chat
Change / verification notes (English): Deep link must re-check queue entitlement; deny if not in queue.

Concern: BLOCK event missing Branch of opening officer (shows customer home branch only)
Change / verification notes (English): Audit Branch = acting user's branch; also record customer home branch if available.

Concern: Activate after Ready to Activate not linked to prior OB approval chain in audit trail
Change / verification notes (English): Traceability from block/submit → each approve → activate.

Concern: Search on Rejected tab (if present) broken or absent vs Pending
Change / verification notes (English): If search supported, Account Number + Customer Name; else document N/A.

Concern: Rejected Date/Time uses opening Created Date instead of reject timestamp
Change / verification notes (English): Rejected Date/Time = actual reject Confirm time.

Concern: Prototype HTML still shows standalone Pending Other Branches Opening — UAT build must not
Change / verification notes (English): Treat prototype as historical; assert URS 1.1 consolidated UI in UAT.

Concern: E2E: Not Allowed after prior Allowed+Approval pending still in queue — pending retains old path
Change / verification notes (English): Config flip must not auto-kill or auto-approve existing pendings without policy.

Concern: E2E: Pagination page 2 Proceed opens correct account not page-1 row
Change / verification notes (English): Row action binds to correct ID under virtualisation.

Concern: E2E: Special Rate Rejected then verify OB Approved history still auditable
Change / verification notes (English): SR reject after OB approve: account not active; audits show both actions.

Concern: COB → Opening Account handoff customer with existing other-branch account hits wrong mode
Change / verification notes (English): If COB creates customer only, first account path; if account already exists elsewhere, rule applies.

Concern: Pending list response includes full KYC/PII beyond grid columns
Change / verification notes (English): Minimise payload; stepper fetch authorized separately.

Concern: Current Stage colour coding (if any) fails WCAG contrast
Change / verification notes (English): Text enums remain readable without colour-only meaning.

Concern: Opening officer sees success but Branch A never receives queue item (routing miss)
Change / verification notes (English): Verify workflow assignee mapping to customer's original branch approval group.

Concern: Audit still writes APPROVAL_REQUIRED events under without-approval mode
Change / verification notes (English): No spurious OB approval audits; only standard activation/SR events.

Concern: Headquarters super-user sees all branches' OB pendings contrary to workflow queue rules
Change / verification notes (English): If HQ override exists, document; else must follow level visibility only.

Concern: Previous on first step exits stepper without confirm discard
Change / verification notes (English): Safe navigation; Pending unchanged.
